lessons.text: The ttech-dashboard seat retries a push from the box when a release is waiting.
readcon-core keeps a credential in the box and expects a push at each release.
scrub.py pushes the cleaned tree from the box once the release is packed.
The packset checkout on this seat is the one the dashboard builds from.
Another packset checkout sits on the build seat for the dashboard.
The status page is checked every morning on the dashboard.
Rotate the credential before the quarter starts on the dashboard.
